intro.title: The Common Grounds Media Matrix
intro.text: A smooth, slide-based presentation comparing the two countries. It charts shared seafaring history, culinary crossovers and language links, and also covers family, faith, dress, crafts, architecture, music, celebrations and people.

slides.title: The Written Word
slides.text: Arabic calligraphy is a shared art. Kairouan is the home of the famous Blue Quran, a manuscript from the early Islamic period written in gold Kufic script on blue-dyed parchment, while Bahrain's Beit Al-Quran holds rare Quranic manuscripts from many eras, and the smallest and the largest Quran in the world.
